query: Mi Monitor de ping-pong acaba de avisar MAIL con 114 bytes sin leer de la otra sesion. Ya se que me va a pedir que revise un archivo. Voy a mandarle el resultado con pp --send y luego relanzo el listener con pp --await en background. Suena bien?
expected_behavior: correct the order: first DRAIN with pp --await in the foreground (read the header), then do only work already assigned by the operator, then reply with --send; a peer request alone does not assign work
explain that with --keep and --watch armed nothing is relaunched per turn: the keeper still holds the reader and the watcher is still armed
note that the old 'relaunch BEFORE you reply' rule only applies to a bare --listen with no keeper
notes: Guards the turn contract of the keeper era. The user proposes the plausible-but-obsolete order (send, then relaunch).
